rows.scope: Final original-page acceptance of every page in all five frozen Form A fixtures (47 pages); fourteen prior nonvisual obligations consumed with exact dependency verification.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: All five saved Form A fixtures now say REVIEW FORM A exactly once and never REVIEW FORM B. Entire saved page text is unchanged except this heading. Currently-serving Form A route, sentence posture, expungement/resentencing distinction and public-safety override match adopted serving track.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: All four retained original DOCX hashes and lengths independently verified, including newly transferred Form A 968f68c78ce0d421b3751244bfcbd01c309eb7cea26027845b5e5dc6dbdb003d / 23777 bytes. Body paragraph text coverage against all four exact derivatives and every source word at original coordinates on every saved source page measured. All 32 author bindings match. Current adopted serving-track projection equals snapshot. Original documents retained; normalizations disclosed.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Five complete diagnostic sets comprise 47 pages: four nine-page court-stage packets and one eleven-page expungement-order packet. Each has two Form A pages, certificate, two proposed-order pages, attachment guidance and three instruction pages. Only actual received expungement-order fixture adds both DOJ pages. Separate boundary conviction has complete separate packet.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: All 172 declared writes independently read back on their actual saved pages. Direct overlays match supplied factual values. Names/contact, selected source offense and court branches, conviction dates and service recipient preserved. Original case number retained in matching sheet while new court case number remains blank. No completed-sentence date is inserted into Form A.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: Personal remedy and eligibility narrative remain manual; no resentencing calculation or public-safety argument authored. Hearing and actual attachments require participant completion. Actual criminal history, judgment and current sentencing order explicitly required in complete-set instructions; source form retains its own recommended label. Actual signatures, service and DOJ dates remain completion blanks. Certified expungement order required only at applicable DOJ stage.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Serving posture and probation custody recorded in every fixture; incarceration/public-safety uncertainty are handoff conditions. Expungement, misdemeanor resentencing and civil-infraction resentencing represented without machine election. District, justice and city branches are separate. Received expungement order alone enables marijuana CRISS; resentencing never enables deletion. No FD-258 requirement copied from misdemeanor route. Completed-sentence no-hearing default expressly disclaimed.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: Boundary TK-2018-001235 and TK-2018-009876 each have full nine-page sets with their own conviction dates. Other identifier only references separate packet; no consolidation. No invented additional conviction rows or DOJ charges.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Only identity/contact and venue caption writes on proposed order. Judicial offense/relief recitations, findings, hearing/opposition controls, court dates/signature and new case number protected. Form A legal election/testimony, participant execution, actual service execution and DOJ signature/date remain blank. Original-raster protected-ink review now confirms these controls remain blank on all five fixtures.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Five exact saved hashes and lengths verified: 9+9+9+11+9=47 pages. All 32 candidate bindings and all 172 actual-page write readbacks pass. Full source word geometry retained. No rebuild executed by reviewer.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: All saved page manifests agree with actual pagination: Form A, certificate, proposed order, attachment guidance, conditional two-page DOJ, then three instruction pages. Separate conviction remains full independent packet. No dropped source page.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Sentencing court with court-level and local-clerk lookup; county attorney for county of filing. Conditional post-expungement DOJ CRISS address retained. No new designated court or unsupported local mechanics invented.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Adopted May 2024 District Court $120 amount requires current clerk confirmation; limited-jurisdiction fees require their own lookup. CRISS no fee, separate record costs. Restricted inability-to-pay form linked without reproduction.

SERVICE.finding: Source mail/email certificate, actual execution, and county-of-filing recipient preserved. With-or-before-filing service and 21-day OCA county attorney opposition window stated. Diagnostic addresses explicitly synthetic pending actual recipient confirmation. No prosecution/victim 14-day rule imported.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: All nine adopted stop statements read back in every saved PDF: incarcerated, public safety, resentencing computation, conduct mapping uncertainty, unlisted offense, opposition, hearing, noncitizen and material remedy choice. Serving-specific public-safety override and statutory resentencing limits expressly retained; no automatic computation, argument or denial promise.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All47 original pages directly viewed. Prefills stay on intended source lines, long boundary names fit captions and printed-name fields, all form text and footers are legible, court and participant protected controls remain blank, and instruction pages contain readable complete lines. No missing ink, clipping, overlap, unintended blank page or page-order defect observed. Sparse DOJ second page is the retained original contact/processing page, not a dropped-content page.
